standard.summary: AutoController 在多少步后才开始生效，避免训练初期不稳定状态误触发干预。默认 100。
standard.effect: 前 100 步 AutoController 处于静默观察状态，不执行任何干预；100 步后开始监控并可能触发策略。
standard.whenToUse: 总步数的 10%~20% 是合理的预热范围。总步数 200 步可设为 20~40；总步数 1000 步可设为 100~200。
standard.avoidWhen: 不建议设为 0（训练刚开始 loss 不稳定，立即监控容易误判）。

standard_en.summary: How many steps pass before the AutoController becomes active, so the unstable early phase does not trigger interventions. Default 100.
standard_en.effect: For the first 100 steps the AutoController only observes and intervenes in nothing; after that it starts monitoring and may fire a strategy.
standard_en.whenToUse: 10% to 20% of the total steps is a sensible warmup. With 200 total steps use 20 to 40; with 1000 use 100 to 200.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not set it to 0 -- the loss is unstable right at the start and monitoring from step 0 misjudges easily.

advanced.principle: 预热期内所有监控信号（loss 窗口、GSNR 统计、CLIP 漂移）正常积累，但不触发任何干预动作。预热结束后再开始评估。
advanced.tradeoffs: 预热期过长则早停/LR 衰减的保护效果推迟；过短则噪声信号可能导致误触发。

advanced_en.principle: During warmup, all monitored signals (loss window, GSNR statistics, CLIP drift) accumulate normally but no intervention fires. Evaluation begins after warmup ends.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Too long a warmup delays early-stop/LR-decay protection; too short and noisy signals can false-trigger.
